items.text: the sound shelf's react button just says react; its colour shows on or off (screen readers still hear which)
on a phone, the sound shelf's labels no longer run into each other: two touch sounds read like "sweep +1", a look's own links read "links", and any label too long for its button ends in an ellipsis
Founders Club says how to unlock the pack on another device: join again there with the same email
open a whole pack: drop a pack's zip anywhere on Current, or choose it with open file. No unzipping; its looks, beats and bytebeats all go in at once
Founders Club says the pack is already in your Current, with a way to each part; saving a copy is for another device or a plotter
beats from a pack get their own group in Start from (Packs) and don't count against your three free beats
the founding pack's G-code files no longer call themselves a Paths reward
once Current is installed, the cover drops its install button and share takes its corner
behind the founders club sheet the Paths meter now fades away with everything else
the sheet's rise starts quick and settles slowly into place
in the founders club form, the email agreement has an envelope and the texts agreement a phone
on the cover, once everything has settled, the founders call gives a little jiggle and a glow
